recodes.label: strongly disagree
recodes.evidence_quote: And my mum, she got a job with CITB, and so she kind of knew all about the construction industry and so she kind of thrust some leaflets under my nose and said what about this job? Er, I decided I wanted to come to [this university], and then I sort of found a course to match. So that's pretty the only reason I suppose.
recodes.reasoning: She attributes the route solely to her mother ("that's pretty the only reason"); father (a teacher) is never said to have encouraged her, implying strong disagreement with father-encouragement.
